n = int(input())
strengths = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Sort the strengths
strengths.sort()

# Initialize the count of stewards Jon will support
support_count = 0

# Jon will support a steward if there is at least one steward with strength
# strictly less than him and at least one steward with strength strictly
# greater than him. This means the steward must be in the middle of the sorted list.
